test: records split into observations and the events grammar
the split events give the hand-written schedule's trajectory
an rxode2::et() table expands to rxode2's own doses
column names match without regard to case
mdv is read only to check it
a pre-dose sample passes and a post-dose one is refused
a reset inside a running infusion is refused
rxode2's replace and multiply codes, and doses of unseen ids
each record the split cannot carry is refused by name
an order-dependent event sharing a time is refused
an addl repeat is an event at its own time
a sample at a steady-state record's time is refused
items an event reads are refused on a record that does not
records out of order within or across ids are refused
dose-modifier column names are refused, covariates pass
a table whose every dose is dropped says so
an item set to NULL while its column exists is refused
F0 and FO pass alike, and a bioavailability Fn is refused
censoring columns of an observation are refused
a repeat time that differs only in floating point is caught
the same-time tolerance follows rounding, not the time scale
